title: The Tales Story One - Bangjo
address: Bang Jo (Si Sunthon / Cherngtalay area), Phuket
shortDescription: The Tales Story One - Bangjo is Sansiri's first pool villa collection in Phuket, comprising 13 single-storey villas on about 11,200 sqm.
description: The Tales Story One - Bangjo is Sansiri's first pool villa collection in Phuket, comprising 13 single-storey villas on about 11,200 sqm. Each house has three bedrooms, four bathrooms, a private pool and two parking spaces. Plot sizes run from about 532 to 747 sqm. Architecture is credited to the Edward Tuttle team.
